messages:
suzanne: Alert fired: sustained p95 tail timeouts and 504s on hosted-gateway for tenant=\"lumina\". Started ~1713456600. Symptoms: request_queue_depth hit 1024, continuous-batcher backlog, clients seeing 502/504. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings.
oncall-bot: paging suzanne, kai, support-ops. alert_id=HG-TailTimeout-1713456723 :rotating_light:
car los: copying logs now — do we have a sample request/headers from Lumina? any abnormal seq lengths?
suzanne: pasted sample (sanitized):

```
timestamp=2024-04-05T15:25:34Z level=warn svc=ingress host=gateway-03 tenant=lumina event=RequestQueued depth=1024
timestamp=2024-04-05T15:25:35Z level=error svc=ingress host=gateway-03 tenant=lumina event=RequestTimeout status=504 route=/v1/embeddings latency=12000ms
headers: Content-Length=14200 Authorization=Bearer xxxxxxx Content-Type=application/json
payload snippet: {"input":"<long base64-ish blob>...","max_tokens":0}
```

Looks like a flood of embedding requests with long payloads (many sequences > 4k tokens) started at the same time as a model change reported yesterday.
mira: customer message: "We saw a spike of bulk-embed jobs at 15:24 and then 5xx started. We rolled the client twice, still happened." They attached job manifest — lots of concurrent jobs with large batch_size=128.
kai: preliminary theory: continuous-batcher is getting stuck on a small number of long-seq embedding requests that block batching slots (head-of-line blocking). Without per-tenant concurrency caps and with queue_depth default, the tenant's backlog grows and we hit early rejects/timeouts. Also suspect KV-cache churn due to long keys from large inputs.
carlos: can we get a trace showing where time is spent? queue wait vs runtime?
suzanne: running quick trace query now: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $INT_TOKEN" "https://internal-trace/api/v1/spans?tenant=lumina&from=1713456500&to=1713456800&limit=50" | jq .` snippet: 

```
[{
  "span":"ingress.enqueue",
  "dur_ms":12034
},{
  "span":"continuous_batch.wait",
  "dur_ms":11800
},{
  "span":"runtime.kernel_exec",
  "dur_ms":200
}]
```

Shows almost all time in enqueue/wait, not runtime.
support-ops: customer is asking for root cause and ETA. They want rollback info if model rollout triggered it.
kai: mitigations we can do now: 1) apply per-tenant concurrency cap (short-term) 2) prioritize small/short-seq requests in the batcher 3) throttle large embedding batch_size or enforce content-length cap per request 4) increase queue depth as emergency (but that only shifts latency). I'd prefer 1+2 immediately.
deploybot: starting emergency config change: adding `ingress.rate_limits.overrides.lumina = {concurrency: 40, priority_policy: "favor_short_seq"}` and `ingress.request_limits.max_content_length = 8MB` for tenant lumina. Rolling to gateway-01..04 now.
suzanne: applied to gateway-01 and gateway-02, propagation in progress.
mira: notified customer of temporary throttle and asked them to pause bulk jobs until we confirm recovery. They acked. :white_check_mark:
carlos: re: permanent fix we should: - add per-tenant queue-depth metric & alert - add batcher policy to prefer short sequences and preempt long batches - add a quota for long-seq embeddings and a clear client-facing error (413/429) instead of 504 - investigate model rollout correlation (did new model cause clients to resubmit with bigger payloads?)
ai oncall-bot: alert status: mitigation_in_progress -> update after deploy.
deploybot: rollout complete on gateway-01..04, config diff id=cfg-emer-1713456723 applied.
suzanne: metrics show p95 latency for lumina dropping from 12s -> 220ms over the last 2 minutes. 5xx rate dropping.
support-ops: customer confirms reduced errors and is pausing heavy runs for 1 hour while we follow up.
kai: taking action items: I'll open a tracking ticket for batching policy changes and per-tenant caps (assign to eng-runtime). Also will add an alert that triggers when any tenant queue_depth > 75% of per-gateway limit for > 1m.
suzanne: creating post-incident checklist and timeline. Will include traces, config diff id, and customer comms.
oncall-bot: alert cleared at 1713457005.
deploybot: note: we reverted the 48hr model rollout flag for embeddings for lumina while we dig in.
mira: next steps for support: coordinate with lumina on client-side limits and request sampling. Also request job manifests for last 24h.
carlos: fine. thanks everyone. cc: @product for long-term quotas UX. :thumbsup:
summary: High-level: tenant "lumina" caused continuous-batcher backlog via many concurrent large embedding requests after a model rollout; mitigation applied (per-tenant concurrency cap, prioritize short sequences) and customer notified; action items created for permanent batching policy and alerts.
